message: No detected untrusted source handling: The download_gdrive_data function fetches data from Google Drive but performs no checksum verification, signature check, or authentication of the downloaded content.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs windowed signal splitting and tokenization but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to guard against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates models (SiameseNetwork, NedBERT, SiameseCoatNet, etc.) and loads a YAML config, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection implemented anywhere in the visible training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack implementations are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set being cryptographically isolated, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no explicit mechanism to prevent the evaluation split from being influenced by training data.

No detected input sanitization: The code loads data and passes it through tokenization and dataset construction with no visible shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs before model inference.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no visible checks on model outputs such as NaN guards, probability bounds validation, or threshold enforcement before results are used or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an EEG/emotion neural interface pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
